g.title: PullFlow
g.text: “Every 5 min, check for new starred emails and add them to my Linear backlog.”

g.title: note
g.text: State-diff is what makes pull a TRIGGER
Without it: every 5-min poll re-fires the same items.
With it: agent runs once per actually-new item.
poller_state is persisted so restarts don't replay.
